interpretation_contract: This is a paired common-random-number mechanism audit, not calibration and not confirmation.
Every variant uses the same seeds as its candidate baseline, so paired differences identify model response rather than parameter uncertainty.
Mechanism-deletion and arbitrary-factor variants are explanatory sensitivities and must not be called plausible policy scenarios.
No variant may be promoted to the HTA baseline from this audit. The audit only determines which existing mechanism should be corrected or sourced before recalibration.
